FF1_layout_orientation.caption: Steady propulsion power (last 30 s of 90 s) holding position in a 0.5 m/s current, by layout and current direction. HoloOcean body and isotropic drag; 'not held' means the steady window had allocation residual or saturation; 'not run' marks cases outside the final matrix. L8-HV, L6-STD and L4-H45 coincide because only the four vectored horizontals work on the decoupled simulated body.

FF2_current_drag_models.caption: Station-keeping propulsion power of the 8-thruster BlueROV2 Heavy versus head-on current, under three published, mutually inconsistent surge-resistance descriptions (steady allocation, T200 tables at 15.5 V), with the native closed-loop steady values (HoloOcean drag). Points beyond the identified range or the thruster clamp are omitted.

FF3_transit_categories.caption: Energy of the same settled transit (out, stop, yaw, return, hold) by category at three head-on currents. 'damping' is the share of Unreal's ground-referenced linear damping in the time-mean resistance; it has no physical counterpart in current.

FF4_payload_scheduling.caption: Mission energy on the 0.2 m/s transit with the payload powered for the whole mission or only in the inspection phases (stop, hold, yaw). The sonar's step-up converter is unconfigured, so the inspection values are lower bounds with respect to conversion loss.

FF5_acoustic_share_sensitivity.caption: Share of the acoustic modem (EvoLogics S2C M 18/34, direct link, 2 s period) in the energy of the 0.2 m/s transit, recomputed from the simulated state durations for every published TX setting, RS-232 or Ethernet interface, and airtime from the DESERT PHY or the device bitrate. RX/listen at the published upper bound; 24 V conversion not modelled.

FF6_crosslayer_strategies.caption: Modem energy on the vehicle and over all nodes for each communication strategy on the same 0.2 m/s transit (one seed per strategy). Relays move energy from the vehicle to other nodes.
